# Fact keys

<!-- Generated by tools/keys/keys_md.py from `quail keys --json`; do not edit.
     Regenerate with `make keys`. -->

Every step and every fact key of the default `quail` build (features: `docx`, `pdf`, `text`, `signals`, `refs`, `parties`, `clauses`, `sketch`, `items`, `summary`), with the documentation from the crate that
declares it. Value types and the fields of record values are named in each entry; the
value encoding is described in [concepts.md](concepts.md#3-values). `quail keys PREFIX`
prints the same list for your own build. A build with `--features ocr` adds the step
`ocr.pages@1` (profile `deep`) and the `ocr.*` keys (`ocr.pages`, `ocr.chars`, `ocr.mean_conf`,
`ocr.script`, `ocr.page`), documented in `crates/quail-ocr/README.md`.

Namespaces: [`engine`](#engine) · [`hash`](#hash) · [`docx`](#docx) · [`pdf`](#pdf) · [`text`](#text) · [`signal`](#signal) · [`ref`](#ref) · [`party`](#party) · [`clause`](#clause) · [`sketch`](#sketch) · [`item`](#item) · [`summary`](#summary)

## Steps

In registration order. *Profile* is the lowest profile the step runs in (`dedup` only with `scan --dedup`).

| step | kind | formats | profile | what it does |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `engine.sniff@2` | engine | any | fast | Format and MIME type from the bytes (magic numbers, ZIP directory). |
| `engine.dedup@1` | engine | any | - | `scan --dedup` only: a file whose bytes were already analyzed in the run reuses that record (`engine.duplicate_of`). |
| `hash.identity@1` | analyzer | any | fast | BLAKE3 and XXH3-128 of the whole file, FastCDC chunk hashes. |
| `docx.extract@1` | extractor | docx | fast | Streaming OOXML reader: sections as logical pages, zones, properties, rsids. |
| `pdf.extract@2` | extractor | pdf | fast | Pure-Rust PDF reader: positioned text in reading order, zones, images, OCR flags, raster. |
| `text.extract@1` | extractor | text | fast | Plain text: encoding (BOM, UTF-8/16, chardetng legacy guess), LF line endings, form-feed pages, paragraphs and headings. |
| `text.stats@3` | analyzer | any | fast | Characters, words, scripts and garbage ratio of the extracted text. |
| `text.lang@2` | analyzer | any | fast | Document language with top candidates (lingua + sr/hr/bs layer). |
| `signal.scan@4` | analyzer | any | fast | Identifiers with check digits, dates with roles, amounts, contact domains. |
| `ref.references@3` | analyzer | any | fast | Own document numbers, cited documents, title, instrument kind, page/version markers. |
| `party.candidates@4` | analyzer | any | fast | Company mentions with roles and defined terms, ranked candidates, name statements. |
| `clause.terms@1` | analyzer | any | fast | Contract clauses: governing law, term and renewal, survival and notice periods, termination rights. |
| `sketch.minhash@2` | analyzer | any | fast | MinHash of word 3-shingles with 32 LSH band keys. |
| `sketch.simhash_text@2` | analyzer | any | fast | 64-bit SimHash of weighted word 3-shingles. |
| `sketch.simhash_template@2` | analyzer | any | fast | 64-bit SimHash of entity-masked words (same template, other values). |
| `sketch.layout@2` | analyzer | any | fast | Page-geometry and block-structure SimHashes, heading skeleton digest. |
| `sketch.invoice_layout@2` | analyzer | any | fast | Invoice labels and number-pattern digest. |
| `sketch.text_key@2` | analyzer | any | fast | 128-bit key of the folded words (same words whatever the bytes). |
| `sketch.minhash_compat@3` | analyzer | any | standard | Compatibility mode: byte-compatible port of an existing deployment's MinHash and template sketches. |
| `sketch.page_phash@4` | analyzer | any | standard | 64-bit DCT pHash of each scanned page (embedded scan or 36 dpi render; needs `raster`). |
| `item.lines@5` | analyzer | any | fast | Price items from tables and rate lines: description, quantity, unit, prices, CPV top-3. |
| `summary.card@2` | analyzer | any | fast | File card from all facts (finalizer): kind, parties, dates, amounts, ids, items, flags. |
| `summary.extractive@2` | analyzer | any | fast | 1-3 sentence English summary without a model: card template + subject clause. |
| `summary.outline@1` | analyzer | any | fast | Document outline: headings (numbered, keyword, capitals, type size) with page ranges, bounded. |

<a id="engine"></a>

## engine: format sniffing and dedup

Declared by `quail-engine`. 3 keys.

| key | documentation |
|---|---|
| `engine.format` | Detected format, as `quail_core::Format::as_str` (`pdf`, `docx`, `zip`, `image`, `text`, `unknown`). |
| `engine.mime` | Most specific MIME type known from the bytes, e.g. `application/pdf`. |
| `engine.duplicate_of` | On a record reused from an earlier file of the same run with the same bytes (`RunOptions::dedup_by_content`): the locator of that first file. Its record was not re-analyzed: the other facts are the first file's, and its only timing is the `engine.dedup` step. |

<a id="hash"></a>

## hash: identity of the bytes

Declared by `quail-hash`. 4 keys.

| key | documentation |
|---|---|
| `hash.blake3` | BLAKE3 digest of the whole file (`Value::Bytes`, 32 bytes). |
| `hash.xxh3_128` | XXH3-128 of the whole file (`Value::Bytes`, 16 bytes, canonical big-endian). A fast lookup key, not collision-resistant against an adversary: use `BLAKE3` for that. |
| `hash.cdc` | Content-defined chunk hashes in file order (`Value::List` of `Value::U64`, each the XXH3-64 of one chunk). Two files sharing chunk hashes share those bytes. |
| `hash.cdc_count` | Number of content-defined chunks (`Value::Int`). |

## pdf: PDF extractor

Declared by `quail-pdf`. 26 keys.

| key | documentation |
|---|---|
| `pdf.version` | PDF version, e.g. `"1.7"` (catalog `Version` wins over the header). Text. |
| `pdf.page_count` | Number of pages in the document (not only the extracted ones). Int. |
| `pdf.encrypted` | The file has an `/Encrypt` dictionary (owner- or user-password protected). Bool. |
| `pdf.producer` | Info `Producer`. Text. |
| `pdf.creator` | Info `Creator`. Text. |
| `pdf.author` | Info `Author`. Text. |
| `pdf.title` | Info `Title`. Text. |
| `pdf.subject` | Info `Subject`. Text. |
| `pdf.keywords` | Info `Keywords`. Text. |
| `pdf.created` | Info `CreationDate`. Date. |
| `pdf.modified` | Info `ModDate`. Date. |
| `pdf.created_utc_offset` | UTC offset of `CreationDate`, e.g. `+02:00`, when it has a non-zero one. Text. |
| `pdf.modified_utc_offset` | UTC offset of `ModDate`, e.g. `-05:00`, when it has a non-zero one. Text. |
| `pdf.incremental_updates` | Incremental updates appended after the first revision (`%%EOF` sections minus one, minus the extra section of a linearized file). Int. |
| `pdf.linearized` | The file is linearized ("fast web view"). Bool. |
| `pdf.has_xmp` | The catalog has an XMP metadata stream. Bool. |
| `pdf.signature_fields` | Signature form fields. Int. |
| `pdf.signed` | At least one signature field carries a signature value. Bool. |
| `pdf.form_fields` | Terminal `AcroForm` fields (signatures included). Int. |
| `pdf.has_javascript` | The document contains JavaScript actions. Bool. |
| `pdf.embedded_files` | Files in the `EmbeddedFiles` name tree. Int. |
| `pdf.fonts` | Font names used by the extracted pages, subset tag stripped, deduplicated, sorted. List of Text. |
| `pdf.image_only_pages` | Extracted pages that are an image with (almost) no text. Int. |
| `pdf.pages_needing_ocr` | Extracted pages flagged `needs_ocr`. Int. |
| `pdf.scanned_pages` | Extracted pages that are scans needing OCR: image-only, or mostly an image whose text layer is too thin or garbage (a bad OCR layer, e.g. Cyrillic read as Latin). A scan with a usable OCR layer is not counted. Int. |
| `pdf.is_scanned` | More than half of the extracted pages are `SCANNED_PAGES`: the document is a scan that needs OCR. Emitted for every PDF with an extracted page. Bool. |

<a id="text"></a>

## text: text statistics and language

Declared by `quail-text`. 18 keys.

| key | documentation |
|---|---|
| `text.chars` | Characters of the document text, whitespace excluded (Int). |
| `text.words` | Word-like tokens (words, numbers, codes) of the document text (Int). |
| `text.pages_with_text` | Pages with at least one non-whitespace character (Int). |
| `text.script` | Dominant script of the letters: `latin`, `cyrillic`, `greek`, `other`, or `mixed` when no script has 80 % of the letters (Text). Absent without letters. |
| `text.script.latin` | Share of letters in Latin script (Float, 0..=1). |
| `text.script.cyrillic` | Share of letters in Cyrillic script (Float, 0..=1). |
| `text.script.greek` | Share of letters in Greek script (Float, 0..=1). |
| `text.script.other` | Share of letters in any other script (Float, 0..=1). |
| `text.garbage_ratio` | Document-level garbage ratio, see `crate::garbage` (Float, 0..=1). |
| `text.garbage_pages` | Pages with enough text to judge whose garbage ratio exceeds `crate::garbage::NEEDS_OCR_RATIO` (Int). |
| `text.lang` | Most likely language, ISO 639-1 (`sr`, `hr`, `en`, ...); `conf` is its score (Text). |
| `text.lang_top` | Top candidates as a list of `[code, score]` pairs, best first (List). |
| `text.page_lang` | Language of one page, with the page as evidence; `conf` is its score (Text). |
| `text.encoding` | Plain-text files: lowercase WHATWG name of the detected encoding (`utf-8`, `utf-16le`, `windows-1250`, `iso-8859-5`, ...); `conf` is its confidence (Text). |
| `text.encoding_confidence` | Plain-text files: confidence of the encoding, 1 for a BOM or valid UTF-8, a heuristic in `[0.3, 0.9]` for a guessed legacy encoding, see `crate::decode` (Float). |
| `text.encoding_bom` | Plain-text files: the file starts with a byte-order mark (Bool). |
| `text.decode_errors` | Plain-text files: byte sequences that could not be decoded and became U+FFFD; absent when there were none (Int). |
| `text.line_endings` | Plain-text files: line endings before normalization to LF: `lf`, `crlf`, `cr`, `mixed` or `none` (Text). |

<a id="sketch"></a>

## sketch: similarity sketches

Declared by `quail-sketch`. 19 keys.

| key | documentation |
|---|---|
| `sketch.minhash` | MinHash signature of the word 3-shingles of the normalized, folded text (`Value::Bytes`, 128 rows × 4 bytes little-endian; see `crate::minhash`). Compare with `crate::jaccard_estimate`. Absent below `crate::minhash::MIN_SHINGLES` distinct shingles. |
| `sketch.minhash_bands` | LSH band keys of `MINHASH` (`Value::List` of 32 `Value::U64`, band index mixed in, so all bands can share one index). Two files sharing any key are candidates. |
| `sketch.minhash_shingles` | Distinct word 3-shingles behind `MINHASH` (`Value::Int`). |
| `sketch.simhash_text` | 64-bit SimHash of the weighted word 3-shingles (`Value::U64`). Compare with `crate::hamming`. |
| `sketch.simhash_template` | 64-bit SimHash of the entity-masked words: numbers, dates, amounts, codes, names, URLs and e-mail addresses replaced by their class (`Value::U64`). |
| `sketch.layout` | 64-bit SimHash of the page geometry: quantized block boxes, kinds and zones of the first pages (`Value::U64`). Only for documents with block boxes (PDF). |
| `sketch.layout_blocks` | Blocks with a box that went into `LAYOUT` (`Value::Int`). |
| `sketch.structure` | 64-bit SimHash of the block-kind sequence: headings and levels, lists, tables and their shape, paragraph runs (`Value::U64`). Any format with blocks. |
| `sketch.headings` | Digest of the heading skeleton (heading texts, numbering stripped, lowercased), the `structural_fp` of `crate::compat` as a big-endian integer (`Value::U64`). Compare for equality. Absent with fewer than two headings. |
| `sketch.invoice_layout` | Invoice layout digest: which of 16 invoice labels occur, plus the shapes of invoice-number-like codes (`Value::U64`, see `crate::invoice`). Compare for equality. |
| `sketch.invoice_labels` | Invoice labels found (`Value::Int`, 1..=16). |
| `sketch.invoice_number_patterns` | Distinct invoice-number shapes found (`Value::Int`). |
| `sketch.text_key` | XXH3-128 of the folded words joined by one space (`Value::Bytes`, 16 bytes): the same words, whatever the bytes, spacing, case, diacritics or script. Absent below 400 characters. |
| `sketch.compat_minhash` | Python-compatible version signature (`Value::Bytes`, 128 rows × 8 bytes little-endian), see `crate::compat`. |
| `sketch.compat_minhash_bands` | Python-compatible LSH bucket keys of `COMPAT_MINHASH` (`Value::List` of 32 `Value::Text`, `"<band>:<16 hex>"`). |
| `sketch.compat_shingles` | Distinct shingles behind `COMPAT_MINHASH` (`Value::Int`). |
| `sketch.compat_template` | Python-compatible template SimHash of the entity-masked words (`Value::U64`). |
| `sketch.page_phash` | 64-bit DCT pHash per scanned page (`Value::List` of `Value::U64`), aligned with `PAGE_PHASH_PAGES`. |
| `sketch.page_phash_pages` | Zero-based page indices of `PAGE_PHASH` (`Value::List` of `Value::Int`). |

## summary: file card and summaries

Declared by `quail-summary`. 9 keys.

| key | documentation |
|---|---|
| `summary.card` | The file card (Record: `format kind ordinal title title_source lang script pages number cites cites_total parties parties_total dates amounts currencies ids personal_ids items sketch producer author company flags`, absent fields left out; see the README). |
| `summary.card_text` | The card as compact `key: value` lines within the token budget (Text). |
| `summary.card_tokens` | Estimated tokens of `CARD_TEXT` (Int, see `crate::tokens`). |
| `summary.extractive` | 1–3 sentence English summary without a model (Text). |
| `summary.subject` | The subject sentence, verbatim (Record: `text`, `lang`?, `method` = `clause`, `recital`, `operative` or `textrank`, `label`?), evidence: its page. |
| `summary.outline` | The document's headings with page ranges (Record: `method` = `headings` or `windows`, `total`, `pages`, `sections` = list of `title level page end_page source`, pages zero-based; `truncated`?). |
| `summary.digest` | The bounded summary input of a document of any length (Text: `FACTS` = the card, then the whole `TEXT` when it fits, else `OUTLINE`, `START` and per-section `EXCERPTS` copied verbatim). |
| `summary.digest_tokens` | Estimated tokens of `DIGEST` (Int, see `crate::tokens`). |
| `summary.llm` | The LLM summary (Record: `text`, `subject`?, `title_en`?, `method` = `llm` or `extractive_fallback`, `model`, `checked`, `cached`, `input` = `digest` or `map_reduce`, `calls`). Feature `llm`. |
